subject: Follow-up on MetaDefender Core not starting after the upgrade
body:
Hello Marcus,

Issue: after the upgrade to 5.13.2, the Core service stops about ten seconds after it starts.

What we found:
- The Core log says port 8008 is already in use.
- Process 4312 holds that port and looks like an old Core process from before the upgrade.

Next steps:
1. You: end process 4312, start the Core service and tell me whether it stays running.
2. You: send the installer log from the upgrade.
3. Me: send the steps for stopping the services cleanly before an upgrade.
4. Me: ask our engineering team why the old process was still running.

Background on stopping and starting the services: https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/core/administration/start-stop-services

claims_needing_verification.claim: The old Core process was left running by the upgrade installer.
claims_needing_verification.reason: Not yet confirmed with engineering or in the installer log.
